name: MDOH
summary: An entactogen, stimulant, and psychedelic first synthesised by Alexander Shulgin. MDOH is an analogue of MDA. The drug is described as having highly psychedelic effects. The drug is suspected to be a serotonin releasing agent. The drug has not seen widespread use. The drug is reported to have a number of side effects such as urinary retention and a heavy comedown.

uses.en: It has seen very little use and has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它的使用非常少，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它的使用非常少，没有医疗用途。

fact.en: MDOH is MDA with a hydroxyl group attached to its nitrogen. Shulgin described it in PiHKAL, where it stood out among the N-substituted MDA relatives for its psychedelic effects.
fact.zh: MDOH 就是在 MDA 的氮原子上接一個羥基。舒爾金在《PiHKAL》中描述過它，它在 N-取代 MDA 親戚中以迷幻作用突出。
fact.zhHans: MDOH 就是在 MDA 的氮原子上接一个羟基。舒尔金在《PiHKAL》中描述过它，它在 N-取代 MDA 亲戚中以迷幻作用突出。
